sources.citation: Voegelin, C. F. & F. M. Voegelin. 1964. Languages of the World: African Fascicle Three. Anthropological Linguistics (ERIC microfiche).

sources.citation: Santandrea, S. 1948. Little known tribes of the Bahr el Ghazal basin. Sudan Notes and Records 29(1): 78-106.
sources.note: Feroghe listed among languages 'not placed' (quoting Tucker 1940:20); the only accent/tone remark (p. 93) concerns the names Biri vs Bviri, not Feroge.

sources.citation: Vanneste, M. 1951. Review of Santandrea 1950 Comparative Linguistics. Kongo-Overzee 17(2): 185-187 (Dutch).
sources.note: Describes contents of Santandrea 1950 (wordlists, sound changes, comparative grammar); nothing on accent/stress.
No phonology; bibliography = Santandrea 1969 (only descriptive ref), Bennett 1983, Boyd & Pasch 1988, Moseley 2010.
